pg_data_lead: Each Nurelo product works with its own master data and product-specific modules by default. That keeps every area clear on its own.
pg_data_r1_dd: Own master data and own, product-specific modules for each product.
pg_data_r2_dd: One shared database for several products, if you want that.
pg_data_r3_dd: You activate further modules as needed, without reinstalling.
st_pg_title: Nurelo Residential: care software for residential care facilities
st_pg_desc: Nurelo Residential manages residents, care planning, staff rota and medication in residential care facilities, with its own master data and its own modules. Hosted in Germany.
st_pg_f1_p: All information about residents in one place, from admission to the record.
st_pg_f2_p: Care planning and care documentation in the same system, with reports for quality inspections.
st_pg_f3_p: Shift planning, leave and absences for your team.
st_pg_f4_p: A complete overview of medication with an administration log.
st_pg_f5_p: Record and evaluate the care levels of your residents.
st_pg_f6_p: Manage your eKV in the same system.
st_pg_f7_p: Assign costs to the areas of your facility.
st_pg_f8_p: An overview of the wages of your staff.
am_pg_title: Nurelo Home care: care software for home care services
am_pg_desc: Nurelo Home care plans routes and records services under SGB XI and V for home care services, with its own master data and its own modules. Hosted in Germany.
am_pg_f1_p: Route planning with vehicle and staff assignment.
am_pg_f2_p: Record services under SGB XI and V in one workflow.
am_pg_f3_p: Manage vehicles and assign them to routes.
am_pg_f4_p: All information about your clients in one place.
am_pg_f5_p: A complete overview of medication with an administration log.
am_pg_f6_p: Document visits on the go, right on site.
am_pg_f7_p: Keep the personnel files of your team digitally.
hn_pg_title: Nurelo Emergency call: software for home emergency call providers
hn_pg_desc: Nurelo Emergency call manages participants, devices and alarm forwarding to the control centre and bills monthly fees, with its own master data and its own modules. Hosted in Germany.
hn_pg_f1_p: All information about your participants in one place.
hn_pg_f2_p: Manage devices and assign them to participants.
hn_pg_f3_p: Forward alarms to the control centre.
hn_pg_f4_p: Connect smartwatches as emergency call devices.
hn_pg_f5_p: Manage wireless call buttons as emergency call devices.
hn_pg_f7_p: Manage the device contracts of your participants.
